# LionStone Concrete Coating LLC (LionStone Floors)

> Premier commercial, industrial, and residential concrete coating contractor headquartered in Wilbraham, MA, serving all of Massachusetts and Connecticut with **20 years of epoxy and urethane installation, service, and repair experience** and authorized **Global Drain Technologies — Silver Alliance Slot Drain Installer & Consultant** certification.

## Core Flooring & Drainage Systems
- **100% Solids Industrial Epoxy Flooring**: High-build commercial and manufacturing bay systems (10,500+ PSI compressive strength), safety aisle striping, and high-traffic quartz broadcasts.
- **Cementitious Urethane Mortar**: Three-component heavy-duty flooring (3/16" to 3/8") engineered for thermal shock (212 F+ steam washdowns), food and beverage processing, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, and organic acid resistance.
- **Global Drain Technologies Slot Drains, FoodSafe Drains & Trench Drains**: Authorized Silver Alliance installer and consultant providing turnkey concrete saw-cutting, pre-sloped grate-free T304/T316 stainless steel slot drains, sanitary FoodSafe drains, heavy-load forklift-rated trench drains, concrete pitching/sloping, and waterproof epoxy or urethane mortar tie-in.
- **Novolac Chemical-Resistant Systems**: Secondary containment coatings built for harsh solvents, fuels, and industrial chemicals.
- **UV-Stable Polyaspartic Flake & Metallic Systems**: Seamless decorative and high-durability flooring for commercial showrooms, automotive bays, residential garages, and basements.
- **Polished, Stained & Densified Concrete**: Multi-stage mechanical honing, lithium silicate densification, and architectural finishes for retail, warehousing, and institutional buildings.
- **Commercial Stair Towers & Integral Sanitary Cove Base**: Non-slip quartz stair treads, risers, and seamless wall-to-floor cove transitions.

## Technical Standards & Surface Preparation
- **Mechanical Surface Preparation**: Heavy 3-phase planetary diamond grinding with HEPA dust extraction to achieve ICRI CSP-2 through CSP-5 slab profiles.
- **Moisture Mitigation & Slab Repair**: Moisture vapor barriers, control joint filling, crack chasing, trench rehabilitation, and spall remediation.
- **Facility Scheduling**: Off-hours, overnight, weekend, and scheduled plant shutdown mobilizations across Massachusetts and Connecticut to minimize operational downtime.
